applicabilityBasis.summary: USDF is redeemable for USDT, while strategy profits are distributed to the separately staked asUSDF wrapper. Under owner ruling D17, these features do not establish a payment-stablecoin exclusion. Applicability remains uncertain pending qualified token-specific analysis of the repayment obligation and any securities or deposit exclusion.

genius.notes: Reviewed 2026-10-01 under D17: Aster's FAQ specifies USDT redemption, a 0.1% fee and a separate yield-bearing asUSDF token. Crypto payout and yield marketing do not establish a GENIUS exclusion or authorization. The prior 2026-08-14 non-payment-token assessment and its sources are preserved in the curation history; no token-specific legal determination is asserted.
